### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one pairgenomealign run (alignment/, assemblyscan/, cutn/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): genome id in a column named sample (or in the first column), one column per factor such as a clade. Enables the design filters and grouping. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table genome-id column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and filter genomes by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `SKIP_ASSEMBLY_QC` | — | Set (--var SKIP_ASSEMBLY_QC=true) for a run with --skip_assembly_qc: no assemblyscan/ reports, so the assembly statistics collection is pruned. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`assemblyscan/stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/assemblyscan/stats.py) | Assembly statistics of each genome from assembly-scan's JSON report. | `genome`, `contigs`, `total_length`, `max_contig_length`, `mean_contig_length`, `median_contig_length`, `min_contig_length`, `n50`, `l50`, `gc_pct`, `n_pct`, `contigs_over_1kb`, `contigs_over_10kb`, `contigs_over_100kb`, `contigs_over_1mb`, `contigs_over_1mb_pct` |
| [`last/split_identity.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/last/split_identity.py) | One row per pairwise genome alignment from LAST's one-to-one summary (``*.o2o.tsv``). | `pair`, `target`, `query`, `aligned_bp`, `percent_identity`, `percent_identity_no_gaps`, `target_sequences`, `target_length`, `query_sequences`, `query_length`, `target_aligned_pct`, `query_aligned_pct` |
| [`last/split_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/last/split_matrix.py) | Substitution matrix and evolutionary distances of each one-to-one genome alignment. | `pair`, `target`, `query`, `blocks`, `columns_analyzed`, `p_distance`, `jc69_distance`, `f81_distance`, `k80_distance`, `t92_distance`, `identical_columns`, `substituted_columns`, `transitions`, `transversions`, `ts_tv_ratio`, `target_gap_columns`, `query_gap_columns`, `A_to_C_pct`, `A_to_G_pct`, `A_to_T_pct`, `C_to_A_pct`, `C_to_G_pct`, `C_to_T_pct`, `G_to_A_pct`, `G_to_C_pct`, `G_to_T_pct`, `T_to_A_pct`, `T_to_C_pct`, `T_to_G_pct` |
| [`last/synteny_links.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/last/synteny_links.py) | Synteny links between the target and each query genome, from the PSL export of the one-to-one alignment. | `pair`, `target`, `query`, `label`, `chrom_a`, `start_a`, `end_a`, `pos_a`, `chrom_b`, `start_b`, `end_b`, `pos_b`, `weight`, `aligned_bp`, `identity_pct`, `category`, `rank` |
| [`last/train_params.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/last/train_params.py) | Alignment scoring parameters ``last-train`` fitted for each genome pair (``*.train.tsv``). | `pair`, `target`, `query`, `training_percent_identity`, `score_scale`, `deletion_open_cost`, `insertion_open_cost`, `deletion_extend_cost`, `insertion_extend_cost`, `strand_setting` |
| [`nf-core/pairgenomealign/genomes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/pairgenomealign/recipes/genomes.py) | The nf-core/pairgenomealign genome hub: one row per query genome, every per-genome number. | `genome`, `aligned_bp`, `percent_identity`, `target_aligned_pct`, `query_aligned_pct`, `blocks`, `k80_distance`, `ts_tv_ratio`, `contigs`, `total_length`, `n50`, `gc_pct`, `gaps`, `gap_bp`, `target`, `pair` |
| [`seqtk/cutn_gap_lengths.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seqtk/cutn_gap_lengths.py) | Length distribution of the assembly gaps of each genome (``seqtk cutN`` BED). | `genome`, `gap_length_bp`, `log10_gap_length`, `gaps`, `gaps_pct`, `gap_bp` |
| [`seqtk/cutn_gaps.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seqtk/cutn_gaps.py) | Assembly gaps per genome, from the poly-N regions ``seqtk cutN`` reports. | `genome`, `gaps`, `gap_bp`, `sequences_with_gaps`, `median_gap_bp`, `max_gap_bp` |
